places-krokar-longobards-in-italy-places.story: From Osilnica it runs 371 km to Osilnica; allow about 6 h 24 of riding. On the way it passes Snežnik-Ždrocle, Škocjan Caves, Idrijska Bela - Belca Water Barrier on the and Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power. The highest point is about 850 m. It crosses from Slovenia into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
